title: SAM 3.1 point-selected video mask
description: Track one object from include and exclude points on the first frame using the existing local SAM 3.1 checkpoint. Review the decoded mask before approving it for editing.

evidence: Local SAM3.1 first-frame include/exclude tracking succeeded: prompt 61e54018-74fc-4152-877c-03563e5b18e3, 832x480, 17 frames at 16 FPS, 19466-byte grayscale MP4, SHA-256 512453b93efdd259cf13cadc37bb73cc84fba0f9b4318f4683aeef5a8025ca88. One cleared fixture; no general occlusion or identity quality claim.
Uses the installed SAM 3.1 checkpoint, first frame and one tracked object. Selecting points does not submit a job; generated masks require explicit review.
